purpose: Prevent the DWG POLYLINE writer from silently discarding modeled PFACE/MESH values that have no corresponding body fields or contradict their encoded record counts.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

implementation.behavior: PFACE output requires the type bit only, default curve/smooth metadata and default base point, extrusion, widths and thickness. Its group-71/72 counts must equal the actual coordinate and face record counts. MESH output requires default base point, extrusion, widths and thickness because these have no fields in its documented body; its M×N vertex dimensions must equal the owned vertex count. Validation runs before staged entity bytes are published.

pfaceRefusals: closed flag without a documented PFACE flag field
vertex count inconsistent with coordinate records
face count inconsistent with face records
meshRefusals: M×N counts inconsistent with owned vertices
generatedControls.failureRetry: Each tested refusal preserves the writer buffer; after restoring the omitted values to their default profile, the same writer successfully encodes PFACE and MESH.

validation.fixturePolicy: Controls are generated in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: The controls establish bounded encoder admission and atomic refusal/retry, not complete PFACE/MESH semantics or interoperability across producers.
Native consumer geometry behavior and broader support claims remain unqualified.
supportClaimEffect: Closes only the tested silent-loss paths for omitted PFACE/MESH DWG body fields; no broad support claim is promoted.
